mapper.select: SELECT NVL(( SELECT SUM(NVL(oi.SAVED_AMOUNT, 0)) FROM OFT_ORDERS o JOIN OFT_ORDER_ITEM oi ON oi.ORDER_NO = o.ORDER_NO WHERE o.USER_NO = #{userNo} AND o.ORDER_STATUS != 'CANCELED' ), 0) AS totalSavedAmount, NVL(( SELECT SUM(NVL(oi.SAVED_AMOUNT, 0)) FROM OFT_ORDERS o JOIN OFT_ORDER_ITEM oi ON oi.ORDER_NO = o.ORDER_NO WHERE o.USER_NO = #{userNo} AND o.ORDER_STATUS != 'CANCELED' AND TO_CHAR(o.ORDERED_AT, 'YYYYMM') = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMM') ), 0) AS monthlySavedAmount, NVL(( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM OFT_ORDERS o WHERE o.USER_NO = #{userNo} AND o.ORDER_STATUS != 'CANCELED' ), 0) AS totalOrderCount, NVL(( SELECT SUM(NVL(o.FINAL_AMOUNT, 0)) FROM OFT_ORDERS o WHERE o.USER_NO = #{userNo} AND o.ORDER_STATUS != 'CANCELED' ), 0) AS totalPurchaseAmount FROM DUAL

SELECT TO_CHAR(o.ORDERED_AT, 'YYYY-MM') AS yearMonth, SUM(NVL(oi.SAVED_AMOUNT, 0)) AS savedAmount FROM OFT_ORDERS o JOIN OFT_ORDER_ITEM oi ON oi.ORDER_NO = o.ORDER_NO WHERE o.USER_NO = #{userNo} AND o.ORDER_STATUS != 'CANCELED' GROUP BY TO_CHAR(o.ORDERED_AT, 'YYYY-MM') ORDER BY yearMonth

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT oi.PRODUCT_NO AS productNo, oi.PRODUCT_NAME AS productName, SUM(NVL(oi.SAVED_AMOUNT, 0)) AS savedAmount FROM OFT_ORDERS o JOIN OFT_ORDER_ITEM oi ON oi.ORDER_NO = o.ORDER_NO WHERE o.USER_NO = #{userNo} AND o.ORDER_STATUS != 'CANCELED' GROUP BY oi.PRODUCT_NO, oi.PRODUCT_NAME ORDER BY savedAmount DESC, productName ASC ) WHERE ROWNUM <= 5

SELECT NVL(SUM(NVL(oi.SUBTOTAL, 0)) / NULLIF(SUM(NVL(oi.QUANTITY, 0)), 0), 0) AS averagePurchaseUnitPrice, NVL(SUM(NVL(oi.SUBTOTAL, 0) * NVL(oi.SAVING_RATE, 0)) / NULLIF(SUM(NVL(oi.SUBTOTAL, 0)), 0), 0) AS averageSavingRate FROM OFT_ORDERS o JOIN OFT_ORDER_ITEM oi ON oi.ORDER_NO = o.ORDER_NO WHERE o.USER_NO = #{userNo} AND o.ORDER_STATUS != 'CANCELED'

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT oi.PRODUCT_NO AS productNo, oi.PRODUCT_NAME AS productName, SUM(NVL(oi.QUANTITY, 0)) AS totalQuantity, SUM(NVL(oi.SAVED_AMOUNT, 0)) AS savedAmount FROM OFT_ORDERS o JOIN OFT_ORDER_ITEM oi ON oi.ORDER_NO = o.ORDER_NO WHERE o.USER_NO = #{userNo} AND o.ORDER_STATUS != 'CANCELED' GROUP BY oi.PRODUCT_NO, oi.PRODUCT_NAME ORDER BY totalQuantity DESC, savedAmount DESC, productName ASC ) WHERE ROWNUM <= 3

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT oi.PRODUCT_NO AS productNo, oi.PRODUCT_NAME AS productName, TO_CHAR(o.ORDERED_AT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS orderedAt, oi.QUANTITY AS quantity, oi.SUBTOTAL AS subtotal, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY o.ORDERED_AT DESC, oi.ORDER_ITEM_NO DESC) AS rn FROM OFT_ORDERS o JOIN OFT_ORDER_ITEM oi ON oi.ORDER_NO = o.ORDER_NO WHERE o.USER_NO = #{userNo} AND o.ORDER_STATUS != 'CANCELED' ) WHERE rn <= 3 ORDER BY rn
